title: The policy prior helps, JEPA reranking hurts, and hierarchy remains negative
decision: Audit prompt-size versus reasoning-length generalization before training a deployable future-action prior.
plain_summary: Across three seeds, the supervised action prior beats the JEPA planner at every in-range length, while allowing the JEPA to rerank more prior proposals gives back the gain; oracle future menus show that deep latent simulation can help, but current wide-CEM hierarchy does not beat simple controls.
